SHOWAVE Grid Tool

LED wall planning and signal mapping

Wall Setup
Split Display Builder

Enter each separate display as width x height in metres. Add left, center, or right in any order. Split gaps are empty spacer zones, not virtual cabinets, and routing starts cleanly inside each display zone.

Mixed Panel Builder

Each enabled row is a complete wall setup: cabinet size, pixel size, columns, rows, gap, and number offset. Use this for transparent LED 500 x 1000 mm / 128 x 128 px, P3.9, P2, P1.9, mesh, or mixed sections.

For mixed 500x1000, transparent mesh, and 500x500 panels. The parser reads metre size, mm cabinet size, pixel resolution, quantity, and left/center/right placement from each zone. Mixed mode draws every cabinet at its real physical size and adds exact zone specs to notes and exports.

Routing And Labels
Click panels to add/remove them from the active route. Double-click or click-blank-mode to blank tiles.
Horizontal Direction
Vertical Direction

Use route numbers, A1 labels, or column x row positions. These cabinets are blanked out, drawn as ghosts, and skipped by signal routing and sending-card port load.

Sending Cards

Signal capacity is calculated from pixel load per sending-card Ethernet port / main signal cable. The SHOWAVE default is 491,520 pixels per main signal run, which derives 30 panels at 128 x 128 px or 15 panels at 128 x 256 px. One main signal cable feeds the first panel; remaining panels use panel-to-panel loop cables.

Power Management

Power capacity is calculated from pixel-derived watt load per main power cable. The SHOWAVE field default uses a 262,144-pixel power budget, which derives 16 panels at 128 x 128 px or 8 panels at 128 x 256 px when using the same reference wattage. One main power cable feeds the first panel; remaining panels use panel-to-panel power loop cables. Final distribution and compliance must be confirmed locally.
